content.value: . A submarine “Titan" moves horizontally in sea and has its axis 15 m below the surface of water. A pitot-tube properly placed just in front of the submarine “Titan" and along its axis is connected to the two limbs of a U-tube containing mercury. The difference of murcury level is found to be 190 mm. Find the speed of the submarine knowing that the specific gravity of murcury is 13.6 and that of sea-water is 1.026 with respect of fresh water.
